s-1.ptxt: Inspect Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror EC Mirror)

item.ptxt: DAY state refers to the state in which the mirror surface is bright, and NIGHT state refers to the state in which the mirror surface is dark.

s2.ptxt: Under the above conditions, check that the mirror enters AUTO mode, the indicator light comes on and the mirror is in the DAY state.

item.ptxt: In the initial setting, operation starts from AUTO mode (DAY state).
Depending on the surrounding conditions, the state may switch from DAY to NIGHT.

s2.ptxt: Check that pressing the mode selector switch below the mirror surface switches the mirror reflection state from AUTO mode → DAY mode.

With the mirror in the AUTO DAY state, cover the ambient light sensor (back side) with your hand and shine a fluorescent light etc. on the rear light sensor, and check that the mirror reflection state switches from DAY → NIGHT; then remove your hand and turn off the light, and check that the mirror reflection state switches from NIGHT → DAY.

atten3.ptxt: Depending on the mirror orientation and surrounding conditions, the mirror reflection may not switch, so change the surrounding conditions and mirror orientation and inspect several times.
